name: iconography
summary: Catalog-level spec for the **icon library** — naming convention, sizing ladder, color application, and how the `Design System/Iconography` gallery renders the canonical Web-ODS-Icons page (LifeLock theme variant of each icon). This unit documents the *catalog as a design token*; the consumable primitive that paints any catalog entry on a surface is `Components/Icon` (governed by `storybook-lifelock/src/components/icon/spec.md`).
